description: Estimate a Twitch streamer's monthly and yearly income from paid subs (tiers 1–3), Prime subs, Bits and ads, using the same formula as the TwitchBoard sub calculator. Defaults use US prices ($5.99 / $9.99 / $24.99), a 50% sub split, $2.50 per Prime sub, $0.01 per Bit and a $3.50 ad CPM. These are estimates; actual payouts vary by country, contract and ad fill.

ad_cpm.description: Streamer ad revenue per 1,000 ad impressions, in USD.

avg_viewers.description: Average concurrent viewers, used for ad revenue.

hours_per_month.description: Hours streamed per month, used for ad revenue.

revenue_split.description: Streamer share of sub revenue: 0.5 standard, 0.7 Partner Plus.
